[SWS_DM_02031] Reporting successful up download to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service RequestDownload or RequestUpload is received,
which results in a positive response, the DM shall report a security event
SEV_UDS_REQUEST_UP_DOWNLOAD_SUCCESSFUL to IdsM (see [26] and table
[SWS_DM_02032]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02032].
